name: 3DEXPERIENCE Lab Website Buttons Functionality Test
goal: Verify all main interactive buttons, dropdowns, and navigation elements on the 3DEXPERIENCE Lab page work as expected.
steps: Click the 'Products' dropdown button in the top navigation header
Click the 'Industries' dropdown button in the top navigation header
Click the 'Learn' dropdown button in the top navigation header
Click the 'Support' dropdown button in the top navigation header
Click the 'About' dropdown button in the top navigation header
Click the Search icon button in the header
Click the Language selection ('LN') icon button in the header
Click the User Profile icon button in the header

expected_results.expected: The 3DEXPERIENCE Lab homepage loads successfully without errors.

expected_results.step: Click the 'Products' dropdown button in the top navigation header
expected_results.expected: The Products dropdown menu opens and displays its available categories.

expected_results.step: Click the 'Industries' dropdown button in the top navigation header
expected_results.expected: The Industries dropdown menu opens and displays its available categories.

expected_results.step: Click the 'Learn' dropdown button in the top navigation header
expected_results.expected: The Learn dropdown menu opens and displays its available categories.

expected_results.step: Click the 'Support' dropdown button in the top navigation header
expected_results.expected: The Support dropdown menu opens and displays its available categories.

expected_results.step: Click the 'About' dropdown button in the top navigation header
expected_results.expected: The About dropdown menu opens and displays its available categories.

expected_results.step: Click the Search icon button in the header
expected_results.expected: A search bar or search overlay appears and is ready for user input.

expected_results.step: Click the Language selection ('LN') icon button in the header
expected_results.expected: The language selection menu opens and displays the available language options.

expected_results.step: Click the User Profile icon button in the header
expected_results.expected: The user profile menu or login dialog opens.
